answers.answer: Finance Commission

answers.answer: যে সংস্থার অস্তিত্ব ও মূল বিধান সংবিধানেই দেওয়া আছে

answers.answer: রাজ্যের রাজ্যপাল

answers.notes: Art 316(1): State Commission Chairman/members appointed by the Governor.

answers.answer: ছয় বছর অথবা ৬৫ বছর বয়স পর্যন্ত, যেটি আগে আসে

answers.notes: Art 316(2): six years or 65 for the Union Commission.

answers.answer: সংসদ
answers.quote: Two or more States may agree that there shall be one Public Service Commission for that group of States, and if a resolution to that effect is passed by the House or, where there are two Houses, by each House of the Legislature of each of those States, Parliament may by law provide for the appointment of a Joint State Public Service Commission to serve the needs of those States.
answers.notes: Art 315(2): Parliament may by law provide for a Joint State PSC.

answers.answer: তাঁদের অন্তত দশ বছর ভারত সরকার বা রাজ্য সরকারের অধীনে পদে থাকতে হবে
answers.quote: Provided that as nearly as may be one-half of the members of every Public Service Commission shall be persons who at the dates of their respective appointments have held office for at least ten years either under the Government of India or under the Government of a State
answers.notes: Art 316(1) proviso: as nearly as may be one-half, ten years under GoI/State.

answers.answer: একজন চেয়ারম্যান ও চারজন অন্য সদস্য
answers.quote: The President shall, within two years from the commencement of this Constitution and thereafter at the expiration of every fifth year or at such earlier time as the President considers necessary, by order constitute a Finance Commission which shall consist of a Chairman and four other members to be appointed by the President.
answers.notes: Art 280(1): a Chairman and four other members.

answers.answer: রাষ্ট্রপতির পাঠানো প্রসঙ্গে সুপ্রিম কোর্টের তদন্ত ও রিপোর্ট
answers.quote: the Chairman or any other member of a Public Service Commission shall only be removed from his office by order of the President on the ground of misbehaviour after the Supreme Court, on reference being made to it by the President, has, on inquiry held in accordance with the procedure prescribed in that behalf under article 145, reported that the Chairman or such other member, as the case may be, ought on any such ground to be removed.
answers.notes: Art 317(1): removal only by President after Supreme Court inquiry on reference.

answers.answer: কোন কোন ক্ষেত্রে কমিশনের পরামর্শ মানা হয়নি ও তার কারণ
answers.quote: It shall be the duty of the Union Commission to present annually to the President a report as to the work done by the Commission and on receipt of such report the President shall cause a copy thereof together with a memorandum explaining, as respects the cases, if any, where the advice of the Commission was not accepted, the reasons for such non-acceptance to be laid before each House of Parliament.
answers.notes: Art 323(1): memorandum explaining non-acceptance of advice and reasons.

answers.answer: সদস্য দেউলিয়া ঘোষিত হলে
answers.quote: the President may by order remove from office the Chairman or any other member of a Public Service Commission if the Chairman or such other member, as the case may be,— (a) is adjudged an insolvent; or (b) engages during his term of office in any paid employment outside the duties of his office; or (c) is, in the opinion of the President, unfit to continue in office by reason of infirmity of mind or body.
answers.notes: Art 317(3)(a): President may remove a member adjudged insolvent, without SC inquiry.

answers.answer: কেন্দ্র বা রাজ্য — কোনো সরকারের অধীনেই আর চাকরি পেতে পারেন না
answers.quote: the Chairman of the Union Public Service Commission shall be ineligible for further employment either under the Government of India or under the Government of a State
answers.notes: Art 319(a): UPSC Chairman ineligible for further employment under GoI or any State.

answers.answer: UPSC-র চেয়ারম্যান বা সদস্য, অথবা অন্য রাজ্য PSC-র চেয়ারম্যান হতে পারেন
answers.quote: the Chairman of a State Public Service Commission shall be eligible for appointment as the Chairman or any other member of the Union Public Service Commission or as the Chairman of any other State Public Service Commission, but not for any other employment either under the Government of India or under the Government of a State
answers.notes: Art 319(b).

answers.answer: ব্যয় আইনসভার বার্ষিক ভোট ছাড়াই তহবিল থেকে দেওয়া হয়
answers.quote: The expenses of the Union or a State Public Service Commission, including any salaries, allowances and pensions payable to or in respect of the members or staff of the Commission, shall be charged on the Consolidated Fund of India or, as the case may be, the Consolidated Fund of the State.
answers.notes: Art 322 states PSC expenses are charged on the Consolidated Fund; the claims state the charging but do not spell out the no-annual-vote implication, which is the standard meaning of 'charged'.

answers.answer: সংসদ, আইন করে
answers.quote: Parliament may by law determine the qualifications which shall be requisite for appointment as members of the Commission and the manner in which they shall be selected.
answers.notes: Art 280(2): Parliament may by law determine qualifications and manner of selection.

answers.answer: গৃহীত ব্যবস্থার ব্যাখ্যামূলক স্মারকলিপি
answers.quote: The President shall cause every recommendation made by the Finance Commission under the provisions of this Constitution together with an explanatory memorandum as to the action taken thereon to be laid before each House of Parliament.
answers.notes: Art 281: recommendations laid with explanatory memorandum as to action taken.

answers.answer: রাজ্য Finance Commission-এর সুপারিশ
answers.quote: the measures needed to augment the Consolidated Fund of a State to supplement the resources of the Panchayats in the State on the basis of the recommendations made by the Finance Commission of the State

answers.answer: সুপ্রিম কোর্টের বিচারপতির মতো একই পদ্ধতিতে ও একই কারণে
answers.quote: There shall be a Comptroller and Auditor-General of India who shall be appointed by the President by warrant under his hand and seal and shall only be removed from office in like manner and on the like grounds as a Judge of the Supreme Court.
answers.notes: Art 148(1): removable only in like manner and on like grounds as a Supreme Court Judge.

answers.answer: রাষ্ট্রপতি, CAG-র পরামর্শে

answers.answer: রাষ্ট্রপতি

answers.notes: Art 76(1): the President shall appoint the Attorney-General.

answers.answer: তিনি রাষ্ট্রপতির আনন্দ-মেয়াদে পদে থাকেন

answers.notes: Art 315(4): if requested by the Governor and with the approval of the President.

answers.answer: নিয়োগের পর সেবার শর্ত সদস্যের ক্ষতি হয় এমনভাবে বদলানো যায় না

answers.answer: তিনি কেন্দ্র বা রাজ্য সরকারের অধীনে আর কোনো পদে থাকতে পারেন না

answers.answer: ভারতের সব আদালতে শুনানিতে হাজির হওয়ার অধিকার
answers.quote: In the performance of his duties the Attorney-General shall have right of audience in all courts in the territory of India.
answers.notes: Art 76(3): right of audience in all courts in the territory of India.

answers.answer: CAG — ব্যয় ভারতের সংহত তহবিলের ওপর ধার্য (১৪৮(৬))
answers.quote: The administrative expenses of the office of the Comptroller and Auditor-General, including all salaries, allowances and pensions payable to or in respect of persons serving in that office, shall be charged upon the Consolidated Fund of India.

answers.answer: শুধু ১
answers.quote: The President shall, within two years from the commencement of this Constitution and thereafter at the expiration of every fifth year or at such earlier time as the President considers necessary, by order constitute a Finance Commission which shall consist of a Chairman and four other members to be appointed by the President.
